name: Reno-Tahoe-Carson minimal regional map
service_refresh: July 2026 (service metadata; individual feature dates vary)
attribution: USGS TNM / Census TIGER / USFS - public domain
license: US public domain (USGS TNM-produced raw vectors)
projection: Spherical AEQD, R=6371008.8m; stored WGS84 geographic degrees * 1e7

simplification.notes: Original source scale varies; no network-routing topology claim. Clip in geographic bounds before and after simplification.

selection.roads: USGS 1:1,000,000 road layer; no local street grid
selection.water: USGS small-scale waterbody polygons >=2 square kilometres
selection.rivers: Named Truckee/Carson/Walker rivers and listed forks, StreamRiver FCODE 460xx only; artificial paths omitted
selection.airports: USGS actual runway polygon outlines, not invented airport symbols

TRK.source: centroid average of USGS runway polygons; public test point, not a saved device center
